gaps.what: No separate dossier: merged into empire-of-kanem with both Cliopatria Names (Q1139762, one Wikipedia article, one dynasty). Its twelve shapes are reviewed there.
gaps.why: merged: one state with the Empire of Kanem

gaps.what: Dates of Sundiata's and Sakura's conquests (Diafunu, Kita, Senegambia, Kaabu, Jolof vassalage) are not on the pages opened; the 1241 gains are confidence-1 bridges. The 1415 growth (+141,000 km2) and the 1463/1468/1475 drops are only partly explained (Mema 1465).
Seshat page for Mali (ml_mali_emp) did not load; infobox 1250 area of 100,000 km2 conflicts with Cliopatria's 973,312 km2 and with the Sundiata page's text.
Founding (9th century / c. 500 / 100 CE) has no year or territory on the page; only 1040-1285 is drawn. The Jolof (1450s) and Denianke (1513/1521-1776) phases of the land need a Futa Toro dossier.
Founding c. 300 and the 650,000 km2 tribute sphere are not mapped; the vassals in the oral-tradition list have no dates; Almoravid 'conquest' 1076-77 is a disputed tradition and only a war entry.
Year of the Manden conquest and the Sosso extent (Gajaaga, Diarra, Dialonkadugu, Bure) are undated; 1227 is a bridge.

No page opened gives an area; the c. 700 founding, Umar I Idrismi's move, Ali I Gaji, Alooma's Kanem expeditions and the Bilala treaty are undated or approximate; the 1630 Wadai drive of the Bilala is not tied to a Bornu border change; Alooma's influence over Hausaland, Aïr, Bilma, Tibesti and Dunama's claim to Kano and the Ouaddaï highlands are not drawn.

problems: bornu-empire is merged into empire-of-kanem (one dossier, both Cliopatria Names, 17 keyframe verdicts). No bornu-empire.json exists; counterpart references to bornu-empire elsewhere (wadai-empire, sokoto-caliphate, border_band specs) should use empire-of-kanem, and the colour agent should give the pair one colour.
Counterpart slugs without a dossier yet (validator warns, no errors): jolof-empire, kaabu, bagirmi-sultanate, state-of-rabih-az-zubayr.
Takrur is run to c. 1285 (Cliopatria ends it in 1235) and Mali's shapes are corrected to exclude Takrur until 1285; the Mali page disagrees (undated) with the Takrur page (c. 1285/1286).
Ghana ends 1201 and Sosso starts 1202; Sosso ends 1235 and Mali starts 1236 (Cliopatria's handovers kept); loss and gain events are one year apart by design, noted in each ledger.

Most Mali events before 1285 and several Kanem-Bornu events before 1500 are confidence 1 or 2 because the Wikipedia pages give no years; the Seshat page for Mali failed to load. WebFetch summarised the pages, so quotes in notes are the fetched wording and some bullets were paraphrased rather than quoted.
No ruler strips were written for any of the five states (no list with years was opened).
